title: Kiritani Haruka — This Place I've Returned To〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, good morning.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Morning, Shizuku. You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I thought I should review the script again since our shoot is coming up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I want it to go well since it'll be our first time appearing on TV as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She seems pretty motivated.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And it's not just us she's worried about...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had no right being the lead in the first place. Especially since I couldn't do anything for the others and ended up leaving the group...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, since we've been given an opportunity to appear on TV alongside Cheerful * Days, I'd like to make the most of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have to make up for what happened back then...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do our best and figure out a way to make our shoot a good one when we appear with everyone from Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like that very much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At the same time, I feel so bad about this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's our first time appearing on TV, but I'm making you all worry about me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We understand, Shizuku...
However, we chose to appear on iHaz as a group.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, there's no turning back.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm such a mess...
If only I were a stronger person.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think you already are, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Remember what we talked about on that one program we were on together? You had just been chosen to be the lead for Cheerful * Days.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course I remember.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You really are amazing.
The best of the best. It's like you're shining even brighter in person than when I see you on TV...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I want to meet my fans' expectations too, but I'm not sure I can get myself to do what you do, Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sure you can, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You thinking this hard about what you can do for your groupmates and fans means that you're trying your best.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Being the lead means there will be added pressure and responsibilities compared to everybody else...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll be just fine, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I had so little confidence in myself back then, which led to you having to cheer me up, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, is that how you saw our conversation...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Did you see it a different way...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I meant what I said that time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was clear to me that you genuinely cared about your fans and were doing your best for them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The way you sang and performed was proof of that fact. Your hard work speaks for itself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know you did your best to take responsibility as the lead. I also know that it was hard. So hard that it occasionally brought you to tears.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But despite all that pain, you kept trying. You didn't run away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That means you're not a weak person.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, you may see our first TV appearance involving Cheerful * Days as a bad omen of sorts... But I actually think it's a good thing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had a feeling that this would've happened sooner or later anyway. And what happened with Cheerful * Days still weighs on your mind, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, in order for you to just be yourself moving forward, I think it's good that you're being given an opportunity to clear the air now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
So I can be myself...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're saying that... Just as I can't be like you, Airi or Minori, none of you can be like me, yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Exactly. You have a number of qualities that only you possess, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I'd like it if we could work together and push each other forward.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Me too...!
Thank you, Haruka.
